pairs.why: Both show a dark red booth on a mid green wall with a light floor and no real value difference, so A gets a slight edge for its softer, more even wall.
A's light grey stone house sits against bright sky and green hill like the real light-bodied lighthouse and sandcastle, while B's heavy mid-dark purple mass is darker than the real heroes.
A has the large bright peach floor and lighter pale frame that match the real card's value groups, while B's floor and mid-tones run darker and more orange.
A's bright, high-key radial background with a lighter lamp matches the real cards' bright backgrounds, while B drops to a dark purple with dark corners.
The two chairs are nearly identical in key, value groups and floor brightness, so my vector gives no reason to choose.
A has a flat, even striped wall with no halo, like the real card, while B adds a glowing lime halo behind the clock and a dark shelf shadow.
A has darker cast shadows and a stronger value step between the stone and the grass, closer to the real card's deep shadows, while B is flatter and lighter.
B has the bright peach floor and cleaner light stand-out of the real chair, while A's darker orange floor and heavy cast shadow run darker.
